title: Bind a full-width unsigned integer without custom encoding
goal: Bind a UInt128 directly with Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 11 while retaining all 128 bits and ordered padded TEXT; use this for unsigned counters beyond Int64, with explicit string reads.

selectionNotes: TEXT affinity and BINARY ordering of uniformly padded invariant 39-digit strings; no UInt128 reader retrieval is supported. Use GetString and explicit application parsing.
The historical provider10 comparison does not add a .NET 10 foundation.
